messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Restyle the person's hair to match the hairstyle shown in the reference images. Transfer only the hairstyle shape and structure from the references; do not adopt the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve the person's original hair color and all other elements of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please select video 0, then use that video as the starting point for the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: restyle the person's hair according to the reference images. Only transfer the hairstyle from the reference images, not the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve everything else in the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man walks slowly forward toward the camera, then stops and turns his head to look to his left.","camera":"A low-angle, full-body shot that slowly dollies in as the man approaches, ending in a medium shot.","clothing":"A brown and orange plaid three-piece suit with a white dress shirt and a black tie.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Short, dark hair, neatly combed.","identity":"A 3D-rendered man with a medium-brown complexion, short dark hair, and a neutral expression.","scene":"An outdoor paved area under a concrete overpass, with road signs, barriers, and trees visible in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The man's hair changed from a reddish short style to a dark/black short style with a small top knot or bun visible in later frames, resembling the reference hairstyle structure. His face, suit, tie, scene, and walking action remain largely the same.
arguments.requested_change: Restyle the man's hair to match the reference hairstyle shape, preserving his original hair color and all other video elements.
uncertain: Whether the final hairstyle fully matches the reference shape, especially the top knot, because the output frames show only partial views.
unexpected_changes: Hair color changed from reddish in the source to black/dark in the output, despite the instruction to preserve original hair color.
